title: [ v 2.2 ]  🚀 Unity 모바일 게임 CI/CD 파이프라인
markdown:
> EC2 + Docker 기반 Jenkins, Nginx, Certbot, Unity CLI, Firebase App Distribution, Slack 알림 자동화 > ✅ > > > > 실행 절차 > > 1. .env 작성 (필요시) > > 1. init-letsencrypt.sh 실행 → 인증서 발급 > > 1. docker-compose up -d > > 1. Jenkins 접속 → 플러그인 설치 (GitHub, Slack) > > 1. Jenkinsfile → GitHub Push → 자동 빌드 실행 > ☝🏻 > > > > 실무 기준 보완 사항 > > - Jenkins 8080 포트 외부 비공개, Nginx만 노출 > > - 인증서 자동 갱신 → certbot renew + nginx reload > > - Slack Webhook, Firebase CLI 인증은 Jenkins Credentials에 저장 > > - Unity 빌드는 GameCI 도커 이미지 활용 (빌드 속도, 확장성 향상) > > - 빌드 결과물(APK) Jenkins 아티팩트로 저장 > > - 테스터 관리 자동화 (manage-testers.sh) > > - 에러 핸들링 및 상세 Slack 알림
📐 아키텍처 ```shell [ GitHub Push ] ↓ [ GitHub Webhook ] ↓ [ Nginx (HTTPS/443, 80) ] ↓ [ Jenkins (Docker, 내부 8080) ] ↓ [ Unity CLI 빌드 (GameCI 도커 or 로컬 Unity) ] ↓ [ APK 생성 ] ↓ [ Firebase App Distribution ] ↓ [ Slack 알림 ] ```
📁 디렉토리 구조 ```shell infra/ ├── docker-compose.yml ├── .env ├── jenkins/ │ └── jenkins_home/ ├── nginx/ │ ├── nginx.conf │ ├── ssl/ │ └── healthcheck.conf ├── certbot/ │ └── init-letsencrypt.sh scripts/ ├── build.sh ├── deploy.sh ├── notify.sh ├── manage-testers.sh unity-project/ └── BuildScript.cs ```
🔐 Jenkins Credentials 설정 - firebase_app_id: Secret Text, Firebase App ID - firebase_token: Secret Text, Firebase CLI 로그인 토큰 - slack_webhook: Secret Text, Slack Webhook URL
🧩 Jenkinsfile ```groovy pipeline { agent { docker { image 'unityci/editor:2022.3.12f1-android' args '-v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock' } } environment { SLACK_CHANNEL = "#cicd" UNITY_PROJECT_PATH = "unity-project" BUILD_OUTPUT_PATH = "build/output.apk" FIREBASE_APP_ID = credentials('firebase_app_id') FIREBASE_TOKEN = credentials('firebase_token') SLACK_WEBHOOK = credentials('slack_webhook') TESTER_GROUP = "testers" } triggers { pollSCM('H/5 * * * *') // 또는 GitHub Webhook } stages { stage('Checkout') { steps { git url: 'https://github.com/your-org/unity-game-repo.git', branch: 'main' } } stage('Unity Build') { steps { sh "chmod +x ./scripts/build.sh" sh "./scripts/build.sh $UNITY_PROJECT_PATH" archiveArtifacts artifacts: 'build/output.apk', fingerprint: true } } stage('Distribute to Firebase') { steps { sh "chmod +x ./scripts/deploy.sh" sh "./scripts/deploy.sh $FIREBASE_APP_ID $BUILD_OUTPUT_PATH $FIREBASE_TOKEN $TESTER_GROUP" sh "chmod +x ./scripts/manage-testers.sh" sh "./scripts/manage-testers.sh $FIREBASE_APP_ID $FIREBASE_TOKEN $TESTER_GROUP" } } } post { success { sh "scripts/notify.sh success" } failure { sh "scripts/notify.sh failure" } } } ```
build.sh ```groovy #!/bin/bash UNITY_PROJECT_PATH=$1 BUILD_PATH="build/output.apk" echo "🔨 Unity 프로젝트 빌드 시작: $UNITY_PROJECT_PATH" /opt/unity/Editor/Unity \ -batchmode \ -nographics \ -silent-crashes \ -logFile /dev/stdout \ -projectPath "$UNITY_PROJECT_PATH" \ -executeMethod "BuildScript.BuildAndroid" \ -buildTarget Android \ -quit if [ -f "$BUILD_PATH" ]; then echo "✅ Unity Build 완료: $BUILD_PATH" else echo "❌ Unity Build 실패" exit 1 fi ```
deploy.sh ```groovy #!/bin/bash FIREBASE_APP_ID=$1 APK_PATH=$2 TOKEN=$3 GROUP=$4 echo "🚀 Firebase에 배포 시작: $APK_PATH" firebase appdistribution:distribute "$APK_PATH" \ --app "$FIREBASE_APP_ID" \ --token "$TOKEN" \ --groups "$GROUP" if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "✅ Firebase 배포 성공" else echo "❌ Firebase 배포 실패" exit 1 fi ```
notify.sh ```groovy #!/bin/bash UNITY_PROJECT_PATH=$1 BUILD_PATH="build/output.apk" echo "🔨 Unity 프로젝트 빌드 시작: $UNITY_PROJECT_PATH" /opt/unity/Editor/Unity \ -batchmode \ -nographics \ -silent-crashes \ -logFile /dev/stdout \ -projectPath "$UNITY_PROJECT_PATH" \ -executeMethod "BuildScript.BuildAndroid" \ -buildTarget Android \ -quit if [ -f "$BUILD_PATH" ]; then echo "✅ Unity Build 완료: $BUILD_PATH" else echo "❌ Unity Build 실패" exit 1 fi ```
manage-testers.sh ```groovy #!/bin/bash FIREBASE_APP_ID=$1 TOKEN=$2 GROUP=$3 # 테스터 추가/관리 로직 (예: CSV 파일에서 테스터 목록 읽어서 추가) # firebase appdistribution:testers:add ... echo "👥 테스터 관리 완료 (그룹: $GROUP)" ```
BuildScript.cs ```c# using UnityEditor; using UnityEngine; public class BuildScript { public static void BuildAndroid() { string path = "build/output.apk"; BuildPipeline.BuildPlayer( new[] { "Assets/Scenes/MainScene.unity" }, path, BuildTarget.Android, BuildOptions.None ); Debug.Log("✅ Android APK 생성 완료: " + path); } } ```
